data.heroTitle: Same-Day Online Doctor Consultation in Ireland
data.heroDescription: Connect with an Irish-registered doctor from wherever you are. Same day, via secure video call. No waiting rooms, no travel, no delays. Global Health connects patients across Ireland with experienced, qualified physicians who deliver thorough clinical assessments to the same standard as an in-person GP visit.
data.detailBody:
What to Expect From Your Consultation

Every consultation is conducted via secure, encrypted video call and follows the same clinical standards as an in-person GP visit. Your doctor will:

  • Take a full clinical history and review your current symptoms in detail
  • Conduct a structured remote medical assessment
  • Provide a clear explanation of findings and a personalised management plan where clinically appropriate
  • Advise on next steps: including whether an in-person review, specialist referral, or further investigations are needed
  • Issue relevant clinical documentation at the doctor's professional discretion

All consultations are delivered at GP level, in full accordance with Irish telehealth and medical practice standards.

Conditions Commonly Assessed

Our service is clinically appropriate for a wide range of acute presentations and ongoing concerns, including:

Respiratory & ENT

  • Cold, flu, sinusitis, and bronchitis
  • COVID-19 symptoms and post-COVID queries
  • Sore throat, tonsillitis, and ear infections
  • Chest infections and persistent cough
  • Mild asthma exacerbations

General & Systemic

  • Fever in adults and children
  • Headaches and migraine assessment and management
  • Urinary tract infections (UTIs) and urinary symptoms
  • Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, and gastritis

Skin & Eye

  • Rashes, eczema flare-ups, and allergic skin reactions
  • Mild skin infections
  • Conjunctivitis and minor eye irritation

Musculoskeletal

  • Back pain, neck pain, and muscle strain
  • Minor musculoskeletal injuries

Chronic Condition Queries

  • Acute worsening of conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, asthma, or reflux
  • Queries about your current treatment plan or medication

Administrative & Preventive

  • Medical certificates when clinically appropriate
  • Short-term preventive care advice
  • Referral for blood tests, imaging, or specialist review where clinically indicated

Why Patients Choose Us

Irish-registered, qualified physicians:

All doctors on our platform are registered to practise in Ireland and operate to the same clinical standards as in-person GP care.

Same-day access:

No waiting weeks for an appointment. Same-day slots mean you get assessed when it actually matters.

Secure and fully private:

Our platform is GDPR-compliant, end-to-end encrypted, and built for clinical confidentiality. Your health data is protected.

Clear, actionable outcomes:

Every consultation ends with a clear clinical plan, what is happening, what to do next, and when to seek further care if needed.

Multi-lingual consultations available:

We serve Ireland's international and expat communities. Consultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian.

How It Works

  • Book your appointment: choose a same-day or advance slot that suits you
  • Complete your health questionnaire: give your doctor the clinical context they need before the call
  • Join your secure video consultation: your doctor assesses your symptoms and answers your questions
  • Receive your clinical plan: follow-up instructions, referrals, or clinical documentation issued at the doctor's discretion

data.heroTitle: Online Sick Cert Assessment in Ireland
data.heroDescription: If you are unwell and unable to work, our Irish-registered doctors can assess your condition via secure video call and provide a medical certificate where clinically appropriate. The same standard you would receive from an in-person GP visit, available the same day.
data.detailBody:
How It Works

  1. Book your consultation. Book a 15-minute online appointment with an Irish-registered doctor.
  2. Complete your video assessment. Join a secure video call for a full GP-level assessment of your symptoms, medical history, and fitness to work.
  3. Receive your certificate, where clinically appropriate. If your doctor determines certified sick leave is medically necessary, your certificate is issued electronically the same day and accepted by employers and educational institutions nationwide.

What This Service Covers

This service is a full GP-level medical assessment of your fitness to work. Following your consultation, your doctor will determine whether certified sick leave is medically necessary based on your symptoms, clinical history, and occupational demands.

A sick cert, also called a sick note, a medical chit, or a medical certificate, is written confirmation from your doctor that you were medically unfit for work, and for how long. You can request a sick note online in Ireland without leaving home: the assessment is a secure video call and, where clinically appropriate, the certificate is issued electronically the same day. Medical certificates issued through our platform are accepted by employers and educational institutions nationwide.

Please note: This service does not cover Illness Benefit Certificates for submission to the Department of Social Protection. Patients requiring documentation for social welfare purposes must attend an in-person GP consultation.

Conditions Commonly Assessed

Our doctors regularly assess patients presenting with:

  • Flu, viral infections, and acute respiratory illness
  • Fever and systemic illness
  • Chest infections and severe cough
  • Gastroenteritis: vomiting, diarrhoea, and abdominal symptoms
  • Migraine and severe headaches
  • Back pain and musculoskeletal injuries affecting ability to work
  • Acute stress, anxiety, and burnout symptoms
  • COVID-19 and post-COVID symptoms
  • Exacerbations of chronic conditions: asthma, diabetes, hypertension
  • Minor injuries affecting functional capacity

Each case is assessed individually. The decision to issue a medical certificate is a clinical judgement made solely by the consulting doctor.

What Your Consultation Includes

Full Medical AssessmentYour doctor will review your symptoms, medical history, occupational demands, and current functional capacity to form a complete clinical picture.

Fitness to Work DeterminationBased on the assessment, your doctor will advise whether you are medically fit to work, require short-term rest, or need a longer period of recovery.

Medical Certificate, Where Clinically AppropriateIf the assessment supports certified sick leave, your doctor will issue an official medical certificate accepted by employers and educational institutions across Ireland. The duration of certified leave will reflect the clinical findings.

Referral or Follow-Up Where NeededIf your condition requires further investigation, specialist input, or in-person evaluation, your doctor will advise you clearly and coordinate next steps.

Important Information Before You Book

  • The decision to issue a medical certificate rests entirely with the consulting doctor and cannot be guaranteed in advance
  • Certificates may cover short-term or extended leave depending on clinical assessment
  • Backdated sick notes are not routinely issued due to the absence of direct clinical assessment at the time of illness
  • This service does not provide Illness Benefit Certificates for the Department of Social Protection: please attend an in-person GP for this purpose
  • If your condition is deteriorating or you are concerned about a serious underlying illness, your doctor will advise on appropriate escalation

Why Patients Choose Us

Same-day accessNo waiting days for an appointment when you are already unwell. Same-day slots are available so you can be assessed and certified when you need it.

Irish-registered doctorsAll assessments are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards.

Accepted nationwideMedical certificates issued through our platform are accepted by employers and educational institutions across Ireland.

Secure and confidentialYour consultation is conducted via encrypted video call in full compliance with Irish data protection and telehealth standards.

Assessed, not rubber-stampedEvery certificate we issue reflects a genuine clinical assessment. Our doctors take your health seriously. Not just your paperwork.

data.detailBody:
Who This Service Is For

This consultation is designed for patients who are currently managing a stable, established condition and wish to ensure their care remains clinically appropriate, effective, and aligned with current medical guidelines.

It is not a replacement for your regular GP. It is a clinically supervised review that ensures your treatment continues to work safely and appropriately for your current health status.

This service is appropriate when your condition is stable. If your symptoms have changed significantly, worsened, or you have new concerns, book a Medical Consultation instead so your doctor can conduct a full assessment.

What Your Consultation Includes

Review of Your Current TreatmentYour doctor will assess the condition being managed, current dosage and duration, your response to treatment, any side effects or concerns, and relevant updates to your medical history since your last review.

Treatment Safety AssessmentA clinical review of potential interactions, contraindications, and any changes in your health status that may affect the safety or suitability of your ongoing care.

Clinical RecommendationBased on the assessment, your doctor will advise on whether your current treatment remains appropriate, requires adjustment, or needs further evaluation. Any clinical documentation or onward referral will be issued at the doctor's professional discretion and in accordance with Irish medical standards.

Escalation Where NeededIf your condition requires more detailed assessment, specialist input, or in-person evaluation, your doctor will advise you clearly and coordinate next steps.

Conditions Suitable for Review

This service is appropriate for stable, established conditions including:

  • Cardiovascular conditions and blood pressure management
  • Diabetes and blood sugar control
  • Respiratory conditions including asthma and COPD
  • Thyroid conditions
  • Cholesterol management
  • Contraception: subject to medical suitability and clinical review
  • Mental health support: anxiety, low mood, and stress management, case-dependent
  • Digestive and reflux conditions
  • Long-term dermatological conditions
  • Other stable chronic conditions currently under GP management

This consultation is appropriate when your condition is stable and does not require immediate in-depth reassessment. New, worsening, or undiagnosed symptoms should be assessed through a full Medical Consultation.

Important Information Before You Book

  • Continuation of any treatment is a clinical decision made solely by the doctor following assessment: it cannot be confirmed or guaranteed in advance
  • Certain complex, high-risk, or controlled conditions may require additional assessment or may not be suitable for review via video consultation
  • If your symptoms have changed, worsened, or you have new concerns since your last review, a full Medical Consultation is more appropriate
  • Further investigations or in-person assessment may be recommended where clinically indicated
  • Our doctors do not routinely manage controlled substances through video consultations

Why Patients Choose Us

Same-day accessNo waiting weeks for a review appointment. Same-day slots mean your care continues without interruption.

Irish-registered doctorsAll reviews are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards.

Clinically supervised, not automaticEvery review is a genuine medical assessment. Your doctor will check that your treatment is still working safely and appropriately. Not simply carry it forward without oversight.

Secure and confidentialYour consultation is conducted via encrypted video call in full compliance with Irish data protection and telehealth standards.

Clear next stepsIf your condition needs more than a review, further tests, specialist input, or an adjusted approach, your doctor will tell you clearly and help you get there.

Our Family Medicine doctors are registered on the Specialist Division in Family Medicine with the Irish Medical Council. The highest level of GP training available in Ireland. They are specifically trained to manage complex, ongoing, and multi-system conditions with the kind of clinical depth and continuity that chronic disease care actually requires. For a new or sudden symptom that appeared recently, our Acute Medical Consultation is more appropriate. Same-day appointments available.
data.detailBody:
Who This Service Is For

This consultation is designed for patients who are already living with one or more diagnosed conditions and need structured, ongoing medical management. Not a one-off assessment.

This is the right consultation if you:

  • Are managing a chronic condition such as hypertension, diabetes, asthma, or thyroid disease
  • Have recently received a diagnosis and need a comprehensive care plan
  • Are an expat or international resident without a registered GP in Ireland managing you long-term
  • Have multiple conditions that interact and need a doctor who understands the full picture
  • Want a doctor who will review your history, track your progress, and adjust your care over time
  • Need coordination across specialists, investigations, and ongoing treatment pathways

What Your Consultation Includes

Full Chronic Disease AssessmentYour doctor will review your diagnosis history, current condition status, medication, symptom control, and any changes since your last review. Building a complete and current clinical picture rather than treating each appointment in isolation.

Personalised Care PlanBased on your assessment, your doctor will develop or update a structured care plan tailored to your condition, lifestyle, and long-term health goals, including monitoring targets, lifestyle recommendations, and clinical milestones.

Treatment ReviewA clinical review of whether your current management approach remains appropriate, effective, and safe given your current health status. Any adjustments are made at the doctor's professional discretion following full assessment.

Preventive Care & ScreeningChronic conditions increase risk across multiple systems. Your doctor will advise on appropriate screening, monitoring, and preventive measures relevant to your specific condition profile.

Coordination of CareWhere specialist input, diagnostic investigations, or in-person assessment are needed, your doctor will coordinate referrals and ensure continuity across your care pathway, so nothing falls through the gaps.

Clinical DocumentationReferral letters, clinical summaries, and other documentation issued at the doctor's professional discretion where clinically appropriate.

Conditions Managed Through This Service

This consultation is appropriate for established, diagnosed chronic conditions including:

  • Cardiovascular
  • Hypertension and blood pressure management
  • High cholesterol and cardiovascular risk reduction
  • Heart disease: ongoing monitoring and lifestyle management
  • Metabolic & Endocrine
  • Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes: monitoring, management, and complication prevention
  • Thyroid disorders: hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, ongoing review
  • Metabolic syndrome and weight-related conditions
  • Respiratory
  • Asthma: ongoing management and exacerbation prevention
  • COPD and chronic respiratory conditions
  • Allergic conditions with ongoing respiratory impact
  • Digestive
  • Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)
  • Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD/GERD)
  • Inflammatory bowel conditions under ongoing management
  • Mental Health
  • Anxiety and depression: ongoing review and management
  • Stress-related conditions requiring structured long-term support
  • Mental health conditions currently under specialist care requiring GP coordination
  • Musculoskeletal
  • Chronic back pain and spinal conditions
  • Arthritis and joint disease
  • Fibromyalgia and chronic pain conditions
  • Skin
  • Chronic eczema and psoriasis requiring ongoing management
  • Acne and dermatological conditions needing structured treatment review
  • Women's Health
  • Hormonal conditions: PCOS, endometriosis, perimenopause
  • Contraception review and ongoing women's health management
  • Thyroid and metabolic conditions specific to women's health
  • Men's Health
  • Testosterone and hormonal concerns
  • Cardiovascular risk in men: ongoing monitoring and lifestyle management
  • Chronic conditions with specific implications for men's health
  • Other
  • Patients with multiple co-existing conditions requiring coordinated holistic management
  • Chronic conditions not listed above: consult us and your doctor will advise on suitability

Why Patients Choose Us

IMC Specialist Division. Family MedicineOur chronic disease doctors are registered on the Specialist Division in Family Medicine with the Irish Medical Council. This is the highest level of GP qualification in Ireland and the standard you should expect for long-term condition management.

Built for expats and international residentsManaging a chronic condition in a country where you have no registered GP is genuinely difficult. We provide the ongoing primary care relationship that expats, international students, and international residents need. In their language, on their schedule, without the administrative barriers of the Irish GP registration system.

Continuity over timeWe maintain your clinical history, care plan, and consultation notes within our secure platform. Where possible we match returning patients with the same doctor, because continuity is not a luxury in chronic disease management, it is a clinical requirement.

20-minute appointmentsChronic conditions cannot be properly managed in 15 minutes. This appointment is structured to give your doctor the time your condition actually requires.

Secure and fully confidentialAll consultations are conducted via encrypted video call in full compliance with Irish data protection and telehealth standards.

data.name: Paediatric GP Online
data.summary: Speak with an Irish-registered GP about your child's health today. Same-day paediatric GP consultations for infants, children, and teenagers via secure video call.
data.seoTitle: Online Paediatric GP Ireland | Children's Doctor Consultation
data.seoDescription: Book an online paediatric GP consultation in Ireland for suitable non-emergency concerns affecting babies, children or teenagers, with referral advice when needed.
data.heroTitle: Online Paediatric GP Consultation in Ireland
data.heroDescription: When your child is unwell, you need answers quickly. Not a week's wait for an appointment. Our Irish-registered doctors provide comprehensive paediatric primary care consultations for infants, children, and adolescents via secure video call. Whether your child has developed a sudden fever, a persistent cough, a rash you can't identify, or a concern that has been worrying you for a while. Our doctors will assess thoroughly, explain clearly, and give you a concrete plan. GP-Led Paediatric CareThis consultation is provided by Irish-registered General Practitioners with clinical experience in child health. It is appropriate for the assessment and management of common childhood illnesses, acute symptoms, and ongoing primary care concerns at GP level. If your child requires assessment by a paediatric consultant or has a complex, multi-system, or specialist condition, our Paediatric Specialist Consultation may be more appropriate. Your GP can also advise on whether a specialist referral is needed following assessment. This service is for non-emergency health concerns. If your child is experiencing a medical emergency, difficulty breathing, severe allergic reaction, loss of consciousness, or any other urgent concern, call 112 or 999 immediately or attend your nearest emergency department.
data.detailBody:
Who This Service Is For

This consultation is appropriate for parents and caregivers seeking medical assessment for:

  • Infants from birth through to the first year of life for common health concerns
  • Children of all ages presenting with acute or ongoing non-emergency symptoms
  • Adolescents requiring confidential, age-appropriate medical assessment
  • Families new to Ireland or without a registered paediatrician or GP managing their child's care
  • Parents who want a second clinical opinion on their child's symptoms or diagnosis
  • Follow-up assessment after a hospital visit or emergency department attendance

This service is not appropriate for:

  • Medical emergencies: call 112 or 999 or attend your nearest emergency department
  • Concerns requiring physical examination that cannot be assessed remotely: your doctor will advise if in-person assessment is needed
  • Routine immunisations and vaccinations: these require in-person attendance

Conditions Commonly Assessed

  • Infections & Acute Illness
  • Fever: assessment, management, and safety-netting advice for parents
  • Cold, flu, and upper respiratory tract infections
  • Chest infections, bronchitis, and persistent cough
  • Ear infections: otitis media and otitis externa
  • Throat infections: tonsillitis and strep throat
  • Urinary tract infections in children
  • Gastroenteritis: vomiting, diarrhoea, and abdominal pain
  • Conjunctivitis and eye infections
  • Hand, foot, and mouth disease
  • Chickenpox: assessment and management advice
  • COVID-19 symptoms in children
  • Skin Conditions
  • Rashes: assessment, identification, and management
  • Eczema and atopic dermatitis: flare management and ongoing care
  • Allergic skin reactions and hives
  • Nappy rash and infant skin concerns
  • Impetigo and mild skin infections
  • Molluscum contagiosum
  • Respiratory & Allergic Conditions
  • Mild asthma: symptom assessment and management review
  • Allergic rhinitis: hay fever and perennial allergic rhinitis
  • Food allergy queries and referral where indicated
  • Recurrent respiratory infections
  • Growth, Development & Nutrition
  • Growth concerns and weight assessment
  • Feeding difficulties in infants and toddlers
  • Nutritional assessment and dietary advice
  • Developmental queries: speech, motor, and behavioural milestones
  • School readiness and learning concerns
  • Toilet training difficulties and enuresis
  • Adolescent Health
  • Acne and skin concerns in teenagers
  • Menstrual concerns in adolescent girls
  • Anxiety, low mood, and stress in teenagers
  • Sports injuries and musculoskeletal concerns in young people
  • General health queries and wellbeing assessment in adolescents
  • Ongoing & Chronic Conditions
  • Asthma management and inhaler technique review
  • Eczema: ongoing management and trigger identification
  • ADHD: initial assessment and referral coordination
  • Recurrent infections: assessment and investigation where indicated
  • Follow-up after hospital discharge or specialist appointment
  • General Paediatric Queries
  • Safety-netting advice for worried parents: when to seek further care
  • School health concerns and medical certificates for school absence
  • Travel health advice for children
  • Referral for blood tests, imaging, or specialist paediatric review where indicated

What Your Consultation Includes

Full Paediatric AssessmentYour doctor will conduct a thorough clinical assessment of your child's symptoms, medical history, developmental background, and current health status, with you present throughout as parent or caregiver.

Clear Explanation of FindingsWe know that receiving medical information about your child can be stressful. Your doctor will explain their findings in plain language, give you a clear clinical picture of what is happening, and answer your questions thoroughly.

Clinical Management PlanBased on the assessment, your doctor will advise on appropriate management, including home care guidance, safety-netting advice, referral for investigations, or onward referral to specialist paediatric services where clinically indicated. Any clinical recommendations are made at the doctor's professional discretion.

Safety-Netting AdviceEvery paediatric consultation includes clear safety-netting. Specific guidance on what to watch for, when to seek further care, and what would indicate that your child needs emergency assessment. This is standard clinical practice and something we take seriously.

Referral & CoordinationWhere specialist paediatric input, including paediatrics, dermatology, ENT, or other specialties, is needed, your doctor will coordinate referral and ensure the appropriate documentation is issued.

A Note on Consent and Confidentiality

Paediatric consultations involve a minor. All consultations for patients under 16 require a parent or legal guardian to be present during the video call and to provide consent for the consultation and any clinical recommendations made.

For adolescent patients aged 16 and over, the doctor will assess capacity to consent on a case-by-case basis in accordance with Irish medical and legal standards.

All patient information, for both the child and the parent or caregiver, is protected under strict GDPR and Irish data protection standards.

When to Seek Emergency Care

This is the most important section on this page.

Call 112 or 999 or attend your nearest emergency department immediately if your child has:

  • Difficulty breathing or is breathing very fast
  • A high fever in an infant under 3 months: any fever in this age group is a medical emergency
  • A rash that does not fade when pressed with a glass: this may indicate meningitis
  • Severe allergic reaction: swelling of the face, lips, or throat, or difficulty swallowing
  • Seizures or convulsions
  • Loss of consciousness or is unresponsive
  • Severe abdominal pain
  • Signs of dehydration: no wet nappies for 8+ hours, sunken fontanelle, dry mouth, no tears when crying
  • Any symptom that is rapidly worsening and causing you serious concern

If you are unsure whether your child's symptoms are an emergency, always err on the side of caution and seek emergency care.

Our service is for non-emergency paediatric concerns. Your child's safety is always the priority.

Why Parents Choose Us

Same-day accessWhen your child is unwell, waiting days for an appointment is not acceptable. Same-day slots are available so your child can be assessed when they actually need it.

Irish-registered doctorsAll paediatric consultations are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards for child health.

You stay in controlYou are present throughout the entire consultation. You ask the questions, you hear the answers, and you make the decisions for your child, with clinical guidance from your doctor.

Clear, jargon-free explanationsWe know that medical information about your child can be anxiety-inducing. Our doctors explain findings clearly, answer your questions thoroughly, and ensure you leave the consultation understanding exactly what is happening and what to do next.

Expat and international family focusMany of our paediatric patients are children of expat or international families in Ireland who do not have a registered GP managing their child's care. We provide accessible, high-quality primary care for children regardless of GP registration status, PPS number, or medical card.

Multi-lingualConsultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian. Removing the language barrier that many international families face when seeking medical care for their children in Ireland.

data.summary: Struggling with weight? Our Irish-registered doctors provide evidence-based medical weight management, including metabolic assessment, GLP-1 eligibility review, and personalised care plans.
data.seoTitle: Online Weight Management Ireland | Doctor-Led Consultation
data.seoDescription: Book a doctor-led online weight management consultation in Ireland for a clinical assessment, personalised guidance and appropriate follow-up options.
data.heroTitle: Online Medical Weight Management in Ireland
data.heroDescription: Sustainable weight loss is not a willpower problem. For most people who struggle with it, there are underlying medical, hormonal, and metabolic factors that no diet plan addresses, because they require clinical assessment, not a calorie counter. Our Irish-registered doctors provide comprehensive medical weight management consultations via secure video call. Identifying the clinical factors driving your weight, building a personalised management plan, and providing the medical oversight that makes long-term change achievable. This is not a diet programme. It is doctor-led medical care for a medical condition.
data.detailBody:
Who This Service Is For

This consultation is appropriate for adults who:

  • Are struggling with weight gain despite dietary and lifestyle changes
  • Have a BMI of 25 or above and want structured medical support

Have weight-related conditions, including pre-diabetes, insulin resistance, hypertension, PCOS, or dyslipidaemia, that are driving or complicating their weight

Want to understand whether they may be eligible for medical weight management treatments, including newer metabolic therapies, following clinical assessment

  • Have tried diet and exercise approaches without achieving sustainable results
  • Are preparing for or considering bariatric surgery and want pre-operative medical assessment and optimisation
  • Want ongoing medical monitoring of their metabolic health alongside weight management

What Your Consultation Includes

Comprehensive Medical AssessmentYour doctor will conduct a detailed review of your medical history, current medications, metabolic risk factors, hormonal profile, eating patterns, physical activity, sleep quality, stress levels, and previous weight management attempts. Building a complete clinical picture of the factors contributing to your weight.

Identification of Underlying CausesWeight gain is rarely a simple equation. Your doctor will assess for hormonal contributors, including thyroid dysfunction, insulin resistance, PCOS, and cortisol dysregulation, metabolic factors, medication-related weight gain, and lifestyle elements that interact with your biology.

Personalised Medical Weight Management PlanBased on your assessment, your doctor will develop a structured, evidence-based management plan tailored to your BMI, health status, lifestyle, and long-term goals, including nutritional strategy, behavioural approaches, metabolic health optimisation, and clinical recommendations at the doctor's professional discretion.

Assessment for Medical Weight Management TreatmentsFor patients who meet the clinical criteria, your doctor will assess eligibility for evidence-based medical weight management treatments, including GLP-1 receptor agonist therapies, in accordance with Irish prescribing standards and clinical guidelines. Eligibility is determined solely by the doctor following full clinical assessment.

Management of Weight-Related ConditionsWhere weight is contributing to or complicating other conditions, your doctor will address these as part of an integrated management plan. Not as separate issues.

Ongoing Review & MonitoringWeight management is a long-term clinical process. Follow-up consultations are available to monitor progress, review metabolic markers, assess treatment response, and adjust your plan as needed.

Conditions Assessed and Managed

Weight management consultations are particularly appropriate for patients with:

  • Metabolic Conditions
  • Overweight and obesity: BMI 25 and above
  • Insulin resistance and pre-diabetes
  • Type 2 diabetes: weight management as part of metabolic control
  • Dyslipidaemia: elevated cholesterol and triglycerides
  • Metabolic syndrome
  • Hormonal Conditions
  • Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS): weight and hormonal interaction
  • Hypothyroidism contributing to weight gain
  • Cortisol dysregulation and stress-related weight gain
  • Menopause-related metabolic changes and weight gain
  • Cardiovascular
  • Hypertension associated with excess weight
  • Cardiovascular risk reduction through weight management
  • Other Weight-Related Conditions
  • Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD)
  • Obstructive sleep apnoea
  • Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD)
  • Osteoarthritis and joint pain related to excess weight
  • Fertility concerns related to weight and hormonal status

A Note on GLP-1 and Medical Weight Management Treatments

GLP-1 receptor agonist medications, including semaglutide-based treatments, have transformed the medical management of obesity and represent a significant clinical advance in evidence-based weight management. They are not appropriate for everyone, and they are not a standalone solution.

Our doctors assess eligibility for GLP-1 and other medical weight management treatments as part of a comprehensive clinical evaluation. Eligibility is determined by clinical criteria including BMI, weight-related comorbidities, previous treatment history, contraindications, and overall health status. Not by patient preference.

Where treatment is clinically appropriate, your doctor will advise on the most suitable approach as part of a structured weight management plan that includes dietary, behavioural, and medical components. Where it is not appropriate, your doctor will explain clearly and advise on the most suitable alternative pathway.

This service does not provide weight management treatments without full clinical assessment. All clinical recommendations are made solely at the doctor's professional discretion following comprehensive evaluation.

Why Medical Supervision Matters

Most weight loss approaches fail not because of a lack of effort but because they do not address the clinical picture. Hormonal imbalance, insulin resistance, medication side effects, sleep disorders, and metabolic dysfunction all contribute to weight gain in ways that cannot be resolved through diet and exercise alone.

Medical weight management identifies and addresses these factors directly. Providing clinical oversight, evidence-based treatment, and ongoing monitoring that makes sustainable change achievable for patients who have not succeeded with other approaches.

It also provides safety. Weight loss, particularly rapid weight loss or pharmacologically assisted weight loss, carries clinical risks that require medical monitoring. Our doctors provide that oversight as a standard part of the service.

Why Patients Choose Us

Irish-registered doctors with metabolic health experienceAll consultations are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland with experience in weight management and metabolic medicine. Operating to full GP-level clinical standards.

Same-day and scheduled appointmentsAvailable same-day for initial assessment or scheduled in advance for planned reviews, because accessing medical weight management support should not require a six-week wait.

Clinically rigorous, not commercially drivenWe assess what is clinically appropriate for your individual profile. Not what is most in demand. If a treatment is not right for you, your doctor will tell you clearly and explain why.

Integrated metabolic approachWeight does not exist in isolation. Our doctors assess and manage the full metabolic picture, including hormonal, cardiovascular, and lifestyle factors, rather than treating weight as a single variable.

Ongoing follow-up availableWeight management is a long-term clinical process. Follow-up consultations are available to monitor progress, review treatment response, and adjust your plan. Ensuring continuity of medical oversight throughout your journey.

Multi-lingualConsultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian. Particularly relevant for Ireland's international and expat community, who frequently face additional barriers to accessing weight management support.

data.heroDescription: 5.Men’s Health Consultation Men's health concerns, erectile dysfunction, low testosterone, reduced libido, and sexual performance, are among the most common and most underreported medical issues affecting men in Ireland. Most men who experience these symptoms never speak to a doctor about them. They should. Because in the majority of cases, these are medical conditions with medical causes, and medical solutions. Our Irish-registered doctors provide confidential, evidence-based men's health assessments via secure video call. No waiting rooms, no awkward face-to-face appointments, no judgment. Just a thorough clinical assessment and a clear plan.
data.detailBody:
What This Service Covers

This is a comprehensive men's health consultation. Not a prescription service. Our doctors conduct a full clinical assessment to identify the underlying medical, hormonal, psychological, or lifestyle factors contributing to your symptoms, and advise on appropriate management based on the findings.

This service covers men's health and sexual health concerns. Women's health concerns including menopause, hormonal conditions, and contraception are assessed through our Women's Health Consultation.

Conditions Commonly Assessed

  • Sexual Health & Function
  • Erectile dysfunction (ED): assessment of medical, vascular, hormonal, and psychological contributors
  • Premature ejaculation and delayed ejaculation
  • Reduced libido and loss of interest in sex
  • Performance anxiety with clinical impact
  • Sexual dysfunction related to diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or medication
  • Hormonal & Metabolic
  • Testosterone deficiency: symptoms, assessment, and management pathway
  • Hormonal imbalance affecting energy, mood, weight, and sexual function
  • Metabolic syndrome and its impact on men's health
  • Weight-related hormonal disruption
  • General Men's Health
  • Cardiovascular risk assessment in men
  • Fatigue, low energy, and mood changes with hormonal or metabolic cause
  • Hair loss with hormonal basis
  • Prostate health queries and referral where indicated
  • General health assessments and preventive care for men

What Your Consultation Includes

Comprehensive Clinical AssessmentYour doctor will conduct a detailed review of your medical history, current symptoms, medications, cardiovascular risk factors, hormonal indicators, psychological factors, and lifestyle influences. Building a complete picture of what is driving your symptoms.

Identification of Underlying CausesMen's health symptoms rarely exist in isolation. Erectile dysfunction, for example, is frequently an early marker of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or testosterone deficiency. Your doctor will assess the full clinical picture, not just the presenting complaint.

Clinical Management PlanBased on your assessment, your doctor will advise on appropriate next steps, which may include lifestyle and metabolic optimisation, referral for blood tests or hormonal assessment, specialist referral where indicated, or clinical recommendations at the doctor's professional discretion.

Ongoing Care PathwayWhere your condition requires structured ongoing management, your doctor will advise on the most appropriate care pathway, including whether a Chronic Disease Consultation would better serve your long-term needs.

Why Men Don't Seek Help, And Why They Should

Research consistently shows that men are significantly less likely than women to seek medical help for health concerns. Particularly those affecting sexual health or perceived masculinity. The consequences of this are serious: erectile dysfunction is a known early warning sign of cardiovascular disease. Low testosterone affects mood, cognition, bone density, and metabolic health. Untreated hormonal imbalance has long-term systemic consequences.

These are not lifestyle inconveniences. They are medical conditions. And they are treatable.

A confidential video consultation removes the barriers that stop most men from getting assessed. No waiting room, no face-to-face awkwardness, no need to explain yourself to a receptionist. Just a doctor, a secure call, and a clinical conversation.

Why Patients Choose Us

Fully confidentialYour consultation is conducted via encrypted video call. No one in your household, workplace, or social circle needs to know you booked an appointment. Your health data is protected under strict GDPR standards.

Irish-registered doctorsAll assessments are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards.

Same-day appointmentsAvailable the same day, because the barrier to booking should be as low as possible for a consultation that most men put off for months.

Clinical depth, not a quick fixWe assess the underlying cause, not just the symptom. A thorough clinical assessment is the only responsible way to manage men's health concerns, and it is what our doctors are trained to provide.

Multi-lingualConsultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian. Particularly relevant for Ireland's international and expat male population.

data.detailBody:
Who This Service Is For

This consultation is appropriate for adults and children presenting with:

  • A new rash, skin change, or lesion that needs clinical assessment
  • An existing skin condition that is flaring, worsening, or not responding to current treatment
  • Acne: from mild to moderate presentations requiring structured medical management
  • Eczema or atopic dermatitis: flare assessment and ongoing management review
  • Psoriasis: assessment and management at GP level
  • A skin lesion, mole, or growth that has changed or is causing concern
  • Allergic skin reactions: urticaria, contact dermatitis, or drug reactions
  • Scalp conditions: seborrhoeic dermatitis, scalp psoriasis, or fungal conditions
  • Skin infections: bacterial, viral, or fungal
  • Chronic skin conditions requiring ongoing GP-level management and monitoring
  • Patients who need a dermatology referral letter to access specialist care

If you have a rapidly spreading rash accompanied by fever, difficulty breathing, or facial swelling. Seek emergency care immediately. Call 999 or attend your nearest emergency department.

Conditions Commonly Assessed

  • Inflammatory Skin Conditions
  • Eczema and atopic dermatitis: including flare management, trigger identification, and ongoing care
  • Psoriasis: plaque, guttate, and scalp psoriasis at GP level
  • Seborrhoeic dermatitis: scalp and facial presentation
  • Rosacea: assessment and management
  • Perioral dermatitis
  • Acne
  • Mild to moderate acne: comedonal, inflammatory, and mixed
  • Acne in teenagers and adults
  • Hormonal acne in women: assessed in conjunction with hormonal assessment where indicated
  • Post-acne pigmentation and scarring assessment
  • Acne management review: patients already on treatment who need a clinical review
  • Allergic & Reactive Conditions
  • Urticaria: acute and chronic hives
  • Allergic contact dermatitis: assessment and allergen avoidance advice
  • Drug reactions affecting the skin
  • Angioedema: assessment and management at GP level
  • Food allergy-related skin presentations
  • Infections
  • Impetigo: bacterial skin infection
  • Cellulitis: assessment and management, with escalation where indicated
  • Folliculitis
  • Fungal skin infections: tinea corporis, tinea pedis, tinea versicolor
  • Molluscum contagiosum
  • Warts and verrucae: assessment and management options
  • Herpes simplex: cold sores and cutaneous herpes
  • Shingles: varicella zoster assessment and management
  • Pigmentation & Lesions
  • Moles and skin lesions that have changed in size, shape, colour, or texture
  • Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation
  • Melasma: assessment and management
  • Vitiligo: assessment and referral where indicated
  • Scalp Conditions
  • Seborrhoeic dermatitis of the scalp
  • Scalp psoriasis
  • Scalp folliculitis
  • Tinea capitis: fungal scalp infection
  • Paediatric Skin Conditions
  • Eczema in infants and children, a core paediatric presentation
  • Nappy rash and infant skin concerns
  • Childhood viral rashes: assessment and management advice for parents
  • Impetigo and skin infections in children
  • Molluscum contagiosum in children

What Your Consultation Includes

Visual Clinical AssessmentSkin conditions are uniquely suited to video consultation. Your doctor can observe the lesion, rash, or skin change directly during the call and conduct a structured clinical assessment based on visual findings alongside your history. Good lighting and a clear camera view significantly improve the quality of assessment. Your doctor will guide you on positioning during the call.

Comprehensive HistoryYour doctor will review the onset, progression, distribution, associated symptoms, triggers, previous treatments, relevant medical history, medications, and family history of skin conditions. Building a complete clinical picture alongside the visual assessment.

Diagnosis and Management PlanBased on the assessment, your doctor will advise on the most likely diagnosis, the appropriate management approach, and what to expect from treatment, including how to monitor your condition and when to seek further review.

Investigation Requests Where IndicatedWhere blood tests, including allergy panels, inflammatory markers, or hormonal assessment for acne, are clinically indicated, your doctor will issue the request on the same day.

Clinical RecommendationsAny clinical recommendations, including topical treatments, systemic treatments, or lifestyle modifications, are made solely at the doctor's professional discretion following full assessment.

Dermatology Referral Where NeededWhere your condition requires specialist dermatology assessment, including suspicious lesions, severe or treatment-resistant conditions, or conditions requiring patch testing, biopsy, or specialist procedures, your doctor will issue a formal referral letter and advise on urgency.

Skin Lesions: When to Act Urgently

Any change in a mole or skin lesion warrants clinical assessment. The ABCDE criteria are the standard clinical guide:

  • A: Asymmetry: one half of the lesion does not match the other
  • B: Border: irregular, ragged, notched, or blurred edges
  • C: Colour: variation in colour within the lesion: shades of brown, black, red, white, or blue
  • D: Diameter: larger than 6mm: approximately the size of a pencil eraser
  • E: Evolution: any change in size, shape, colour, or any new symptom such as bleeding or itching

If your lesion meets any of these criteria, book an assessment promptly. Your doctor will assess the lesion visually and advise on whether urgent in-person dermatology assessment is needed.

Skin cancer diagnosis requires in-person dermoscopy and, where indicated, biopsy. Video consultation allows clinical assessment and urgent referral. It does not replace in-person specialist assessment for suspicious lesions.

What Cannot Be Assessed or Managed Through This Service

Transparency about the limitations of video-based skin assessment is as important as clarity about what we can do:

Suspicious or changing lesions can be assessed visually and referred urgently, but diagnosis requires in-person dermoscopy and biopsy where indicated

  • Isotretinoin (Roaccutane) cannot be initiated through this service: this requires consultant dermatologist assessment and prescription in Ireland
  • Patch testing for contact allergen identification requires in-person attendance at a dermatology centre
  • Skin biopsies require in-person attendance
  • Biologic treatments for severe psoriasis or other inflammatory conditions require consultant dermatology assessment

Your doctor will advise clearly if your presentation requires any of these and will coordinate the appropriate referral.

Preparing for Your Skin Consultation

Getting the most from a video-based skin assessment requires a little preparation:

Good lighting. Natural daylight or a bright lamp directed at the affected area gives your doctor the clearest view

Close-up photos, take clear photos of the affected area before your consultation, these can be shared during the call if needed and help your doctor assess changes over time

Multiple angles. If the lesion or rash has a specific texture, border, or distribution, showing it from multiple angles during the call improves assessment accuracy

Note the history, when it started, what it looked like initially, how it has changed, what makes it better or worse, and what you have already tried

Why Patients Choose Us

Visual assessment via videoSkin conditions are one of the highest-value categories for video consultation. Your doctor can see the condition directly, not just hear a description of it. This significantly improves diagnostic accuracy compared to a phone consultation or text-based triage.

Same-day and advance appointments Skin concerns range from urgent, a rapidly spreading rash, to planned, a chronic condition review. Same-day and advance appointments are available, seven days a week including evenings and weekends.

Dermatology referral coordinated same dayWhere specialist dermatology input is needed, your doctor will issue a formal referral letter on the same day, so you can contact your chosen dermatologist or clinic immediately rather than waiting for a follow-up appointment.

Investigation requests issued same dayWhere blood tests are clinically indicated, allergy panels, inflammatory markers, hormonal assessment, your doctor can issue the request on the same day.

Paediatric skin assessment availableSkin conditions in children, eczema, rashes, infections, and molluscum, are a core part of this service. Your doctor will assess your child's skin concern with you present throughout the consultation.

Irish-registered doctorsAll assessments are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards.

Multi-lingualConsultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian.

data.heroDescription: Hair loss is one of the most common conditions affecting both men and women in Ireland, and one of the least discussed, because most people find it difficult to raise with a doctor face to face. The clinical reality is that hair loss is almost always treatable, particularly when assessed and managed early. The earlier the underlying cause is identified and addressed, the better the outcome. What stops most people is the barrier of the conversation. Not the availability of effective options. Our Irish-registered doctors provide confidential hair loss assessments via secure video call, identifying the underlying cause of your hair loss and advising on the most appropriate evidence-based management pathway for your specific presentation.
data.detailBody:
Why Hair Loss Needs Clinical Assessment

Not all hair loss is the same, and treating the wrong type of hair loss with the wrong approach does nothing at best and can worsen the underlying cause at worst.

Hair loss can result from genetic factors, hormonal changes, nutritional deficiencies, autoimmune conditions, thyroid dysfunction, medication side effects, stress, or scalp conditions, and each requires a fundamentally different management approach. Clinical assessment identifies which type you have before any treatment decision is made.

A doctor who assesses your hair loss properly is not simply confirming what you already suspect. They are ruling out underlying conditions that need to be addressed, identifying factors that are accelerating loss, and advising on what is actually likely to work for your specific presentation.

Who This Service Is For

This consultation is appropriate for adults experiencing:

  • Gradual thinning of hair on the scalp: in men or women
  • Receding hairline or temple thinning
  • Hair loss at the crown or top of the scalp
  • Sudden or patchy hair loss
  • Diffuse hair shedding: increased hair in the shower, on the pillow, or on a hairbrush
  • Hair loss following a significant life event: illness, surgery, childbirth, or severe stress
  • Hair loss alongside other symptoms: fatigue, weight changes, skin or nail changes: that may indicate an underlying condition
  • Concerns about scalp health: dandruff, seborrhoea, or inflammation affecting hair growth
  • Hair loss that has not responded to over-the-counter treatments

Conditions Commonly Assessed

  • Male Hair Loss
  • Androgenetic alopecia: male pattern baldness, the most common cause of hair loss in men
  • Alopecia areata: patchy hair loss with autoimmune basis
  • Telogen effluvium: diffuse shedding following illness, stress, or nutritional deficiency
  • Seborrhoeic dermatitis and scalp inflammation contributing to hair loss
  • Medication-related hair loss: assessment and management
  • Female Hair Loss
  • Female pattern hair loss: androgenetic alopecia in women
  • Telogen effluvium: particularly following childbirth, significant illness, or major stress
  • Alopecia areata
  • Hair loss related to hormonal changes: PCOS, thyroid dysfunction, menopause, or post-partum hormonal shifts
  • Nutritional deficiency-related hair loss: iron, ferritin, vitamin D, B12, and zinc deficiency
  • Traction alopecia: hair loss related to styling practices
  • Medication-related hair loss
  • Both
  • Tinea capitis: fungal scalp infection causing hair loss
  • Scarring alopecia: requires urgent dermatology referral
  • Hair loss as a symptom of systemic conditions: thyroid disease, autoimmune conditions, anaemia

What Your Consultation Includes

Comprehensive Hair Loss AssessmentYour doctor will conduct a detailed review of your hair loss history. Onset, pattern, rate of progression, family history, associated symptoms, current medications, nutritional status, recent life events, and overall health. This structured assessment is the basis for identifying the underlying cause accurately.

Underlying Cause IdentificationHair loss is frequently a symptom of something systemic. Not simply a cosmetic concern. Your doctor will assess for hormonal, nutritional, autoimmune, and medication-related contributors that may be driving or accelerating your hair loss.

Investigation Requests Where IndicatedWhere blood tests are clinically indicated, thyroid function, ferritin, iron studies, hormonal profile, vitamin levels, your doctor will issue investigation requests as part of the consultation, so you can get the answers you need without a separate appointment.

Evidence-Based Management PlanBased on your assessment, your doctor will advise on the most appropriate management approach for your specific type of hair loss, including lifestyle and nutritional optimisation, topical treatments, clinical recommendations at the doctor's professional discretion, and referral where indicated.

Dermatology Referral Where NeededSome hair loss conditions, including scarring alopecia, complex alopecia areata, and presentations that require scalp biopsy, require dermatology specialist assessment. Your doctor will advise clearly if this applies to your case and coordinate referral.

Treatment Options Commonly Discussed

Treatment for hair loss depends entirely on the underlying cause. Your doctor will advise on the most appropriate options based on your clinical assessment. Options commonly discussed include:

  • For Male Pattern Baldness
  • Topical minoxidil: available over the counter in Ireland, effective for early to moderate androgenetic alopecia

Oral and topical clinical treatment options. Assessed and recommended at the doctor's professional discretion following full evaluation of your health profile, age, and risk factors

  • Scalp health optimisation: addressing seborrhoeic dermatitis or inflammation contributing to loss
  • Referral for specialist assessment or procedural options where indicated
  • For Female Hair Loss
  • Nutritional optimisation: addressing iron, ferritin, vitamin D, B12, or zinc deficiency where identified
  • Topical minoxidil: evidence-based for female pattern hair loss
  • Hormonal assessment and management: where PCOS, thyroid dysfunction, or menopausal changes are contributing
  • Clinical recommendations at the doctor's professional discretion based on individual assessment
  • Dermatology referral for complex presentations
  • For Alopecia Areata
  • Assessment and management at GP level for mild presentations
  • Dermatology referral for moderate to severe or rapidly progressing alopecia areata
  • Autoimmune condition management where relevant
  • For Telogen Effluvium
  • Identification and management of the triggering cause
  • Nutritional assessment and optimisation
  • Timeline and expectation management: telogen effluvium is typically self-limiting once the trigger is addressed
  • Monitoring and follow-up

All clinical recommendations are made solely at the doctor's professional discretion following full assessment. Treatment options are discussed based on individual clinical presentation and health profile.

A Note on Early Assessment

Hair loss follows a progressive pattern in most cases. Particularly androgenetic alopecia in both men and women. Hair follicles that have been lost for an extended period are significantly harder to recover than those that are thinning but still active.

This is the clinical argument for early assessment: not vanity, but efficacy. The earlier the cause is identified and the appropriate management initiated, the better the outcome. Waiting until hair loss is advanced significantly narrows the treatment options available.

If you have noticed changes in your hair density, hairline, or shedding pattern, even if you are not sure it is significant enough to see a doctor, book a consultation. Your doctor will tell you honestly whether intervention is warranted and what the options are.

Why Patients Choose Us

Confidential video consultationNo waiting room. No face-to-face awkwardness. No receptionist who knows your name. Just a doctor, a secure video call, and a clinical conversation. Completely private.

Underlying cause identified firstWe assess why your hair is falling out before discussing what to do about it. This is the only clinically responsible approach, and it produces significantly better outcomes than starting treatment based on an assumed diagnosis.

Investigation requests coordinated same dayIf blood tests are needed, and for many hair loss presentations they are, your doctor can issue the request on the same day. You can book your blood test immediately rather than waiting for a follow-up.

Irish-registered doctorsAll assessments are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards.

Multi-lingualConsultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian.

data.detailBody:
Who This Service Is For

This consultation is appropriate for adults presenting with:

  • Acute musculoskeletal injury or sudden onset pain requiring clinical assessment
  • Ongoing or chronic pain conditions that have not been adequately assessed or managed
  • A flare-up of a known musculoskeletal condition requiring timely review
  • Pain following an injury, procedure, or period of immobility
  • Musculoskeletal symptoms alongside a chronic condition: diabetes, hypertension, or inflammatory conditions: that complicate management
  • Patients who need physiotherapy referral, imaging requests, or specialist orthopaedic or rheumatology referral coordinated through a GP assessment

If you are experiencing sudden severe pain, chest pain, pain following significant trauma, or any symptom that concerns you seriously, attend your nearest emergency department or call 999 immediately.

Conditions Commonly Assessed

  • Spinal & Nerve Conditions
  • Acute and chronic lower back pain
  • Neck pain and cervical spine disorders
  • Sciatica and lumbar radiculopathy
  • Disc herniation and associated nerve compression symptoms
  • Thoracic spine pain
  • Joint Conditions
  • Knee pain: including osteoarthritis, ligament concerns, and patellofemoral syndrome
  • Hip pain: including osteoarthritis, bursitis, and referred pain
  • Shoulder pain: including rotator cuff, impingement, and frozen shoulder
  • Wrist and hand pain: including carpal tunnel syndrome and tendinopathy
  • Ankle and foot pain: including plantar fasciitis and Achilles tendinopathy
  • Elbow pain: including tennis elbow and golfer's elbow
  • Muscle & Soft Tissue
  • Muscle strains and tears
  • Soft tissue injuries
  • Tendinitis and tendinopathy
  • Bursitis
  • Sports injuries and activity-related musculoskeletal concerns
  • Chronic & Systemic Conditions
  • Osteoarthritis: assessment, management, and referral coordination
  • Inflammatory arthritis: assessment and rheumatology referral where indicated
  • Fibromyalgia: assessment and integrated management
  • Neuropathic pain: nerve-related pain assessment and management pathway
  • Chronic pain syndromes: structured assessment and ongoing care coordination
  • Post-injury or post-surgical pain: review and management plan
  • Occupational & Lifestyle-Related
  • Work-related musculoskeletal conditions: repetitive strain, postural pain
  • Ergonomic assessment and advice
  • Sports and exercise-related injury assessment

What Your Consultation Includes

Comprehensive Clinical AssessmentYour doctor will conduct a detailed review of your pain history. Onset, location, character, severity, radiation, aggravating and relieving factors, functional impact, and red flag screening. Any existing imaging results, investigation reports, or clinical letters will be reviewed in full.

Red Flag ScreeningMusculoskeletal pain assessment always includes systematic screening for red flag symptoms. Indicators that pain may have a serious underlying cause requiring urgent investigation or referral. Your doctor will assess for these as a standard part of every consultation.

Personalised Management PlanBased on your assessment, your doctor will advise on the most appropriate management approach, which may include:

  • Structured physiotherapy and rehabilitation referral
  • Imaging requests: X-ray, MRI, or ultrasound: where clinically indicated
  • Rheumatology, orthopaedic, or neurology referral where specialist input is needed
  • Lifestyle, ergonomic, and activity modification guidance
  • Clinical recommendations at the doctor's professional discretion

Ongoing ReviewFor chronic or complex musculoskeletal conditions, follow-up consultations are available to monitor progress, review investigation results, and adjust the management plan as needed.

Red Flags: When to Seek Emergency Care

Musculoskeletal pain is almost always benign, but some presentations require urgent assessment that cannot wait for a video consultation.

Seek emergency care immediately if your pain is accompanied by:

  • Bladder or bowel dysfunction: incontinence or retention: alongside back pain. This may indicate cauda equina syndrome, a surgical emergency
  • Severe trauma: fall from height, road traffic accident, or significant impact
  • Sudden severe chest pain: which may indicate cardiac or aortic pathology rather than musculoskeletal cause
  • Unexplained weight loss alongside new or worsening pain
  • Fever alongside joint swelling and pain: may indicate septic arthritis
  • Rapidly progressive neurological symptoms: weakness, numbness, or loss of coordination
  • Pain that is constant, severe, and completely unresponsive to any position or movement

If you are unsure, err on the side of caution and seek emergency care.

Why Musculoskeletal Conditions Benefit From Early Clinical Assessment

Most musculoskeletal conditions are self-limiting. They resolve with appropriate rest, activity modification, and structured rehabilitation. But without clinical assessment, patients frequently either undertreate, returning to activity too soon and causing further injury, or overtreate. Restricting activity unnecessarily and prolonging recovery.

Early clinical assessment identifies what is actually happening, rules out serious underlying pathology, and provides a structured evidence-based management plan that gets you back to full function faster and more safely than waiting it out.

For chronic conditions, osteoarthritis, inflammatory arthritis, fibromyalgia, chronic pain syndromes, early clinical engagement with a structured management plan significantly improves long-term functional outcomes and quality of life.

Why Patients Choose Us

Same-day accessMusculoskeletal pain, particularly acute injury, does not wait for an appointment slot two weeks from now. Same-day consultations mean you get assessed and managed when the clinical window is most effective.

Irish-registered doctorsAll assessments are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards, including systematic red flag screening as a standard part of every musculoskeletal assessment.

Physiotherapy and specialist referral coordinatedWhere physiotherapy, imaging, or specialist referral is indicated, your doctor will coordinate this as part of the consultation, so you leave with a clear pathway, not just a diagnosis.

Imaging requests issued same dayWhere X-ray, MRI, or ultrasound is clinically indicated, your doctor can issue the investigation request on the same day, so you can book your imaging immediately rather than waiting for a follow-up appointment.

Chronic condition expertiseFor patients with long-term musculoskeletal conditions, we provide the structured ongoing clinical oversight that chronic pain and joint disease requires. Not a one-off assessment with no follow-up pathway.

Multi-lingualConsultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian.

data.detailBody:
What This Service Covers

This is a comprehensive women's health consultation conducted at GP level by Irish-registered doctors. Our doctors assess the full clinical picture, medical history, hormonal profile, lifestyle factors, and presenting symptoms, and advise on appropriate management based on the findings.

This service covers women's health concerns at GP level. For acute illness or sudden symptoms, our Acute Medical Consultation may be more appropriate. For ongoing chronic condition management, see our Chronic Disease Consultation.

Conditions Commonly Assessed

  • Contraception & Reproductive Health
  • Contraception assessment and ongoing review: combined pill, mini pill, patch, ring, injection, and non-hormonal options
  • Contraception-related side effects and management
  • Pre-conception health advice and planning
  • Fertility concerns: initial assessment and referral where indicated
  • Hormonal Health
  • Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS): diagnosis support, management, and monitoring
  • Endometriosis: symptom management and referral coordination
  • Premenstrual syndrome (PMS) and premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD)
  • Irregular, heavy, or painful periods
  • Hormonal imbalance affecting mood, weight, energy, and skin
  • Thyroid conditions: particularly relevant to women's hormonal health
  • Menopause & Perimenopause
  • Perimenopause assessment and symptom management
  • Menopause: hot flushes, sleep disruption, mood changes, cognitive symptoms
  • Hormone replacement therapy (HRT): assessment, initiation, and ongoing review at the doctor's discretion
  • Post-menopause health and long-term wellbeing
  • Sexual Health
  • Reduced libido and hormonal contributors
  • Vaginal dryness and discomfort: assessment and management
  • Pain during intercourse: clinical assessment and referral where indicated
  • Sexual dysfunction with hormonal or psychological basis
  • General Women's Health
  • Urinary tract infections and recurrent UTIs
  • Breast health queries and referral where indicated
  • Cervical screening queries and referral coordination
  • Skin and hair concerns with hormonal basis: acne, hair loss, hirsutism
  • Mental health in women: anxiety, depression, postnatal mood concerns
  • Weight management with hormonal or metabolic basis
  • Preventive care and health screening relevant to women

What Your Consultation Includes

Comprehensive Clinical AssessmentYour doctor will conduct a detailed review of your medical history, current symptoms, menstrual and reproductive history, medications, hormonal indicators, and lifestyle factors. Building a complete clinical picture tailored to your specific concerns.

Hormonal & Metabolic EvaluationWomen's health symptoms frequently have hormonal or metabolic roots that are missed in standard acute appointments. Your doctor will assess the full hormonal picture where relevant, including thyroid function, reproductive hormones, and metabolic indicators.

Personalised Clinical Management PlanBased on your assessment, your doctor will advise on appropriate next steps, which may include lifestyle recommendations, referral for blood tests or specialist assessment, clinical recommendations at the doctor's professional discretion, or coordination of ongoing care.

Referral & Care CoordinationWhere gynaecological, endocrinological, or other specialist input is needed, your doctor will advise clearly and coordinate referral to the appropriate service. Ensuring nothing falls through the gaps between primary and specialist care.

Ongoing Care PathwayWhere your condition requires structured long-term management, hormonal conditions, PCOS, endometriosis, or menopause, your doctor will advise on the most appropriate ongoing care pathway.

Why Women's Health Deserves Its Own Consultation

Women's health conditions are chronically underdiagnosed and undertreated. Endometriosis takes an average of eight years to diagnose. PCOS affects one in ten women and is frequently missed or mismanaged. Perimenopause symptoms are routinely dismissed as anxiety or stress. Hormonal contributors to mood, weight, skin, and energy are consistently underassessed in standard acute appointments.

A dedicated women's health consultation exists because these conditions require clinical time, hormonal literacy, and a doctor who approaches your symptoms with the full context of women's health. Not a 15-minute acute slot designed for a chest infection.

A Note on Confidentiality

Women's health concerns, particularly those involving contraception, sexual health, hormonal conditions, and menopause, are among the most personal medical matters a patient can discuss. Our consultations are conducted via encrypted video call, in full compliance with Irish and EU data protection law. Your records are not shared without your explicit consent, and your consultation is completely private.

Why Patients Choose Us

Irish-registered doctorsAll assessments are conducted by doctors registered to practise in Ireland, operating to full GP-level clinical standards. The same standard you would receive from an in-person GP visit.

Same-day and scheduled appointmentsAvailable the same day for urgent concerns, or scheduled in advance for planned reviews, because women's health care should fit around your life, not the other way around.

Fully confidentialEncrypted video consultation, strict GDPR compliance, and complete clinical privacy. No receptionists, no waiting rooms, no one who knows your name at the front desk.

Multi-lingualConsultations available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, and Romanian. Particularly relevant for Ireland's international and expat female population, who frequently face additional barriers to accessing women's health care in a new country.
